title: Run through the remaining fields
statement: Let $m>0$, let $����$, $a_0$, and $����$ be fixed. Let $fs$ be a list of fields and let $j<m$ satisfy $j+|fs|=m$. Let $a$ be a state and $d$ a configuration in the forward scan state with value $a$. Suppose tape $0$, relative to its head, agrees with the tape formed by joining $fs$ at every integer position from $-1$ through its length. Then there is a time $t$ no greater than five times one plus the joined tape length such that at every time $u<t$ the machine is in neither the read state with no stored Boolean value nor the exit state. At time $t$, the configuration is the original one with tape $0$'s head advanced by the offset of the last field of $fs$ if the acceptance predicate holds on the fold of the joined tape from $a$, and by the offset immediately after all fields otherwise; its state is respectively the exit state or the read state with no stored Boolean value.
